extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: club sandwich cut diagonally, two halves, approx. 25 x 11 x 8 cm
extras.notes: three golden toasted slices with light crumb at the cut, wavy lettuce, tomato slices, cheese with softly drooping corners and pink ham; a wooden toothpick with a coloured ball in each half; both cut faces point to the front; the right half 'sandwich_right' is a separate object (origin at its bottom centre) so it can be picked up; no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
